description: Delete a coordinate not used by the normalized obstruction payload or counterexample certificate.
preconditions: redundant_support criterion holds under selected operation semantics
output_witness: normal witness with one fewer coordinate
missing_sublemma: normal-form and payload-transfer sublemmas for arbitrary schemas

description: Identify equivalent support coordinates and quotient each nontrivial class to one coordinate.
preconditions: accepted equivalence relation sound;nontrivial class exists;payload/canonical/status congruence preconditions hold
output_witness: normal witness with contracted coordinate set
support_delta: negative when a nontrivial class exists
measure_decreases: yes for support_size under nontrivial quotient; status preservation proof-ready but not closed

description: Project witness to its active support coordinates.
preconditions: active_support contains all payload/certificate/canonical/family-chain/status data and is a strict subset
output_witness: projected normal witness with inactive support removed
measure_decreases: yes for support_size under strict subset; status preservation proof-ready but not closed

description: Replace the witness by a lower-rank canonical motif with no larger support.
preconditions: accepted compressible canonical motif exists and semantic preservation obligations are named
measure_decreases: yes for lexicographic measure under accepted compression; status preservation open

description: Absorb a support-growth component through the family-chain bounded language after phase3 projection/canonical contract.
preconditions: recognized source-form trigger;fresh target family-chain package;payload/status alignment or named blocker
output_witness: contradiction by bounded theorem or residual smaller-witness candidate
support_delta: closed or negative when residual measure sublemma holds
measure_decreases: conditional: contradiction branch closes; residual branch measure/status open
missing_sublemma: residual measure decrease;counterexample-status preservation or refutation

description: Route a reduced support<=8 witness to the current frontier/shell/tail theorem language.
preconditions: reduction output has support<=8 and selected normal form

description: Use checked tail obstruction chain when reduced witness is in checked support8 tail language.
preconditions: reduced support<=8 witness has checked tail normal form

description: Classify a support>8 witness with no declared reduction or family lift after operation proofs close as a higher_support_escape candidate.
preconditions: support>8;operation proof obligations closed;no reduction operation precondition;family lift unavailable
missing_sublemma: higher_support theoretical bound after operation proofs close
